fact: UBOS released the findings of the 8th Uganda National Household Survey in May 2025, per the article.
UBOS donated 4,050 tablets and six computers previously used in the 2024 National Population and Housing Census, which was therefore enumerated.

UBOS reports finalising and disseminating a thematic report (Disability monograph) from the National Population and Housing Census (NPHC) 2024, showing the census was enumerated in 2024; the document gives no enumeration date.

UBOS reports producing and disseminating UDHS 2022 thematic reports (water quality, refugee health status, family planning, gender-based violence) in FY2025/26; no release date is given, so the document's published date (2026) is used.

UBOS states the National Population and Housing Census 2024 was enumerated door-to-door from 10 May to 26 May 2024 (reference night 9 May), counting 45,905,417 persons and 10,698,913 households; a post-enumeration survey put net coverage at 95.7%.

UBOS presents the final report (Volume I, Main) of the National Population and Housing Census 2024, dated December 2024; preliminary results came out on 27 June 2024 and provisional on 3 October 2024.
Document cites the 2024 National Population and Housing Census as showing 43.3% of Ugandans aged 10+ own a mobile phone, so a census was counted in 2024.
UBOS states Uganda's first-ever digital Population and Housing Census was conducted in May 2024.
UBOS lists the Population and Housing Census (2024 provisional) as a main source and gives a 2024 population of 45.9 million.
The World Bank's WDI lists 2014 as Uganda's latest population census.
The World Bank's WDI lists the 2016 Demographic and Health Survey as Uganda's latest demographic, education or health household survey.
The World Bank's WDI lists an integrated household survey (IHS) of 2015/16 as the source of Uganda's most recent income and expenditure data.
The World Bank's SPI lists a population census in 2014 (censuses 2002 and 2014) within its 2024 scoring round; the line gives no enumeration date, so the census year is used.
